semanticChecks: Resident words/actions versus actual temperature/BP measurements distinguished; unusual observation not cause proof, hot touch not measured temperature. Loose footwear/long hem/wet floor/path cable/broken device distinct, yesterday ability not today certainty, seated/lying movement and transfer risks beyond walking, no age/disability-name-only conclusion.

Risk management prediction/preparedness/prevention, injury-free near miss still record/share facts. Situation/event/confirmed factors/unconfirmed causes separated; team response/recurrence review before harm. Moving wheelchair example distinguishes checked brake-not-applied fact versus unexamined cause, no premature brake causation.

Full Japanese health/condition/complexion and kana learning refs plus complete Burmese retained. Vital signs all4metrics, looked versus measured/planned versus done. Nausea versus actual vomiting, sweat versus fever, image not temperature, swelling/edema location/change. Contracture not temporary muscle tensing, pressure injury not bedridden-only; heat illness versus abrupt-temperature heat shock, vocabulary not self-diagnosis/treatment. Pain/distress context, symptom versus sudden attack, cough/dizziness/numbness resident words and known scope no disease-name inference.

Actual observation/actions per resident/individual plan/facility procedure, changed/risk findings to needed recipient, no text-only unknown technique. Pathogens bacterial/viral/fungal/parasitic examples, unusual fever/vomit/diarrhea/abdominal pain/rash/complexion explicitly to medical staff, symptoms not organism identity and healthy appearance not immunity.

Infection source/path/host chain, hands/items/food routes, human/animal hosts; reducing source/interruption/health support different purposes, available measures need not await all3. Noro/O157 contact, influenza droplets, TB/measles air are learning examples not single-measure sufficiency; actual pathogen/task/current facility guidance retained.

Standard precautions before diagnosis; blood/saliva/nasal discharge/vomit/urine/stool/damaged skin/mucosa contact risk. Select gloves/mask/apron-gown/eye protection by task, not identical set all tasks. Gloves hand contact/apron clothes/goggles eye splash, hat not always everyone; product-fit mask covers nose/mouth/chin, never replaces other precautions.

Disposable glove change resident/care change and dirty→clean by procedure; same pair not multiple people, contaminated surface inside/dispose designated place/then hand hygiene, gloves not handwash substitute. Collective living increased contact, prevent entry/exit/internalspread; hand/environment/items/team combination facility procedure, weakened resistance caution never healthy-person exemption. PPE don/doff/contaminated disposal/product/concentration/time from facility training/guidance, no invented procedure or diagnosis.

Palm rubbing not proof backs/interdigits/thumbs/tips-nails/wrists treated; both hands. Flowing water+liquid soap wet→lather necessary areas→rinse sufficiently→appropriate paper towel dry; watch/ring covered areas prepared per facility rule, around jewelry alone not always sufficient.

Palm/palm then opposite back swap sides, interlace fingers/interdigits plus finger backs, not dominant hand only. Thumb opposite-hand rotating and tips/nails opposite palm as textbook motions, both sides and separate wrists, actual procedure/force trained. Rub agent product amount/all surfaces/dry rubbing, cupped hand not proof dose, no intermediate water rinse/paper wiping. Visible soil liquid soap/flowing water rather than alcohol-only, pathogen/task facility method, washing/rub-disinfection not interchangeable omissions. Recontact contamination, clean/used placement/order and diagram knowledge not actual adequate skill proof.

Body mechanics bone/joint/muscle coordination, resident safety and worker force/low-back burden, diagram not safe transfer guarantee. Base support contact perimeter, appropriate stance/low COM, cane ground point alters support but no no-fall promise; person/device/floor combined. Work close to body/larger leg-gluteal groups to avoid low-back concentration; avoid knees-straight waist-only lifting/loaded twisting, step turn.

Compact limbs as possible/horizontal COM/wholebody/lever fulcrum-force direction, distance alters force but no knowledge-only choice of body fulcrum; no tied joints/painful flexion for posture. Pull language not skin-drag over bedding or affected-arm pull; friction tool horizontal move versus direct drag, skin/pain/ability/equipment.

Resident own ability, lift/sliding sheet/sliding board and trained staff coordination; full-help transfer not lone lifting permission after stance adjustment. Prioritize suitable tools/method not manual lifting, sheet/board separate despite similar names. Worker nutrition/sleep/moderate exercise/rest/time/rhythm, colleague/senior consultation and personal stress coping, unwell/high load report and adjust support not overwork. Actual transfer/reposition needs individual assessment/plan/device instructions/practical training, not untried procedure after memorizing principle.

Earthquake/typhoon/fire risks differ, predisaster facility plan/evacuation routes/contact/community cooperation, who supports whom preassigned. Full example supplies water/food/resident-fit medicines/medical/firstaid/light/radio+batteries/warmth/clothes/hygiene/headprotection plus cash/documents valuables per need/management, not same items/amount/all-inclusive diagram. Plan/expiry/actual needs retained.

Drill alternative route/assisted mobility responsibility/contact failure options, actual checked place/person/state record; packed bag not completed evacuation. Power-dependent oxygen concentrator: preconsult medical staff and device responsible person on who contacts/how supports/backups/power, resident-equipment plan, never text-derived connection/oxygen flow. Supply list with unassigned power-failure responsibility incomplete; roles/contacts/device preparation/mobility plan, equipment presence not usable support system.

Communication thoughts/feelings/information reciprocal and comprehension checked, speaking/listening roles shift, worker finished talking not understanding proof. Speech/writing/sign language are language, sign not arbitrary gesture; face/posture/gaze/gesture nonverbal cues individualized. Attentive listening versus empathy from other perspective versus acceptance of feeling/opinion distinct, not forcing staff conclusion.

Closed yes/no/limited choice supports specific check; open broad thoughts/preferences, closed-only one-sided and repeated why open questions may feel blamed; match purpose/burden. Values upbringing/time/environment/experience, adult respect, resident/family/professional mutual meaning within need. Refused-event repeated why example pauses/listens/short checks as needed, form not good-interaction guarantee.

Repeat key resident words to show listening/check mismatch, exact when/site/feeling, no staff conclusion substitution or yesterday→today change. Facing/eyeheight/speed/calm voice/wait, crossed arms/withdrawal may suggest not listening but individual/cultural meanings differ, no universal forced gaze/posture. Distance/touch person/context/method/force/count and wishes, hand holding not universal warmth, culture generality not individual wish.

Present help choices and each benefit/disadvantage by understandable method, support thinking/choice/expressed intent/respect decision. Purpose explained alone not consent. Nodding before disadvantages incomplete, add information/check understanding/actual choice, consent tied explained help scope. Actual support per condition/plan/procedure, no unconfirmed consent/unperformed support as complete.
